scoring_justification: Recompute direct band gap at Gamma and Gamma-M CBE energy difference from band structure eigenvalues to confirm the paper's reported ranges.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference band gap range and energy difference threshold for Ti0.5Zr0.5NiSn
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper: direct gap ~0.40-0.45 eV, Gamma-M CBE difference 0.002 eV (Section 3.4.2, Fig.4(c), and ESI Tables S2,S3)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper text and figures; tolerance added to account for DFT implementation spread
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are the paper's own reported numbers

items.k_points[ ]: object with keys: label (string), k_coords (list of 3 floats)
items.eigenvalues: list of bands, each band is a list of eigenenergies (float) at each k-point

outputs.description: Band structure eigenvalues along a high-symmetry path. The checker recomputes two quantities: (1) direct band gap at Γ (energy difference between the highest valence and lowest conduction band at k=(0,0,0)), and (2) absolute energy difference between the conduction band minima at Γ and M (k=(0.5,0.5,0)).

output_contract.notes: The agent must use GGA-PBE exchange-correlation. The primitive cell belongs to space group P-4m2 (No. 115) with six atoms. The specific pseudopotentials (SSSP efficiency) are recommended.

steps.description: Recompute direct band gap at Gamma and Gamma-M CBE energy difference; score full if within tolerance windows, decay linearly outside.
